source_analysis: Record the textbook's subject, central questions, concept boundaries, examples, figures and source page references; do not invent unsupported content.
lesson_planning: Plan the whole subchapter before slides, preserving source order when pedagogically relevant and complete coverage.
slides: Prefer short, readable slides with accurate original images and labels.
narration: Use natural, clear spoken explanations grounded in the supplied source and displayed slide; do not invent facts.
highlighting: Link each narrated concept to an unambiguous on-screen element before speech generation.
quality_review: Review missing concepts, misleading diagrams, unsupported claims and mismatched narration.
